description: From the summit ridge of the Roque de los Muchachos the jagged rim of the Caldera de Taburiente runs dark across the middle of the frame, with low dome silhouettes of the observatory strung along the crest. Overhead the sky is dense with stars — La Palma is one of the world's great stargazing islands — and the forested slopes drop into blackness below. Clear model skies (9% cloud) support the crisp, long-exposure feel; nothing here is floodlit.
